item.title: Great Crossing baseball team mourns loss of teen killed in Scott County crash
item.description: Just before 11:30 a.m. on March 23, Great Crossing Warhawks Baseball posted on Facebook that Case Wilson, 16, had passed in the early hours of Sunday morning following an accident.

item.title: UK donor criticizes Barnhart's new role amid athletics revamp
item.description: A University of Kentucky alum and donor sent a letter to President Eli Capilouto, calling the choice to place Barnhart in an executive role without a formal description was "deeply misguided."

item.title: Danville students' 25-year time capsule lesson resurfaces
item.description: A time capsule buried by John W. Bate Middle School students 25 years ago was recently excavated, revealing a variety of items from the turn of the millennium.

item.title: Judge finds former Kentucky governor in contempt of court, orders arrest
item.description: A judge has issued an arrest order for former Kentucky Governor Matt Bevin after he failed to submit complete financial disclosures in his divorce case.

item.title: Months after parent’s warning, state substantiates Scott County coach allegations
item.description: Scott County High School Basketball Coach Sean Woods has been placed on leave as a child protective services investigation unfolds following allegations of inappropriate behavior towards a student.

item.title: Missing 'dangerous' Madison County shooting suspect has extensive criminal record
item.description: Officials emphasize that Morphis is believed to be armed and dangerous, and those who see him or have information regarding his whereabouts should call 911.

item.title: Cold case: Kentucky man vanished in 1997 delivering Easter baskets
item.description: Kentucky State Police are still searching for a man who has been missing for 29 years.

item.title: Tennessee man accused of killing girlfriend found dead on Kentucky riverbank
item.description: A Tennessee man with ties to a woman's death on March 14 in Antioch was found dead on Monday afternoon on the bank of the Cumberland River, according to the Kentucky State Police.

item.title: Kentucky House attempt to impeach Fayette County judge ruled null and void
item.description: A Franklin County Circuit Court judge ordered that the articles of impeachment for Judge Julie Goodman can be debated in the Senate, although they failed to charge her with a specific crime.

item.title: Woodford County inmate allegedly snuck meth into jail
item.description: A Woodford County inmate is facing additional charges without the chance to post bond after allegedly trying to bring methamphetamine into the building.

item.title: London mayor indicted for campaign contribution violations
item.description: London Mayor Randall Weddle was indicted by a Laurel County Grand Jury on four counts of campaign contribution restriction/expenditure limits, stemming from his contributions to the Andy Beshear for Governor campaign and the Kentucky Democratic Party.

item.title: Woman arrested for alleged Montgomery County DUI with kids, drugs in car
item.description: A Montgomery County woman is facing multiple charges after deputies said she was driving under the influence with children in the car.

item.title: Fayette County superintendent pulls name from Missouri job interview process
item.description: The head of Fayette County Public Schools is staying in Lexington after removing his name from a list of candidates for a Missouri superintendent role.

item.title: Kentucky family seeks justice in deadly I-64 crash lawsuit
item.description: An Ohio transportation company is in the hot seat after a lawsuit was filed on behalf of a Kentucky man killed in a fiery 2025 highway crash.

item.title: 1 hurt in crash on major Lexington road, gas meter hit
item.description: The right lane of Nicholasville Road facing downtown has been reopened on Wednesday morning after a crash in the area led to one person being taken to a local hospital.
